text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, Meisho Doto invites me
to join
her for dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. Hop, step, three,
four...

I can tell she's made a real effort to
improve. Her
eye contact could use
some improvement, but her
footwork is
solid. Still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waagh?! Two, three, four! One, twoo...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry, I just... I get embarrassed when
people
cheer me on, and I, um... lose...
my footing...
Nngh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: One, three, two, four, one?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeek, I c-c-can't slow down!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... I'm sorry that happened... I
danced myself
into the corner of the
room.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why does this happen to me? Whenever
I feel I'm
being watched, it's like my
body stops listening...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? If nothing changes,
my
concert performance will be a
disaster...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... the real thing? Wh-what do you
mean
by—oh, that doesn't sound very
good...
choice_data_list: 緊張しないおまじないを探そう

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! Wh-why are we doing a mini
concert? And,
people are actually here
to watch?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's no way! I will do the
apologizing, so
please cancel today's
con—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, is... this where the stage is?!
Th-they're
all... They're all looking at
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeep! I really, really can't do this!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just wondrous!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What a creative and unique entrance!
You truly
are a genius, Doto. Although,
my own smarts
stand supreme!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O... Why... are you here?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... I had heard a sworn ally of
mine was
holding a mini concert, and
so... I simply had to
come and stea—I
mean... lend you my support!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, Doto. We must adorn this stage
with our
unique and novel flair—with it,
we mark the
beginning of a new
theatrical age!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, wait a second... You see, this
concert is
so I can practice—Waaagh!

The venue erupts with energy at the
arrival of our
special guest. Meisho Doto
finishes her eclectic
practice session with
a few new skills up her
sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but, do you think something that
convenient...
a-actually exists?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course it does!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaaagh?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-that s-surprised me... Oh, it's
Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The one and only! And I know just the
charm to
bring you happiness and peace
of mind!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... So, you can fix me? Is there
anything that
can help my nerves when I
dance?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course there is! All it takes is a
one-legged
hopscotch around the track!
It's a race of
endurance. If you trip, it's
game over! ☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hopscotch... around the track?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that's what it takes... I'll start hopping
right
now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hgwaugh!

Meisho Doto immediately trips on her
first hop.
This solution appears to
double as some good
core training.
